data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Miltiades', meaning 'soldier of God' or 'merciful one'. Miltie is a powerful name evoking courage, faith, and devotion. The name Miltie carries the meaning “Soldier of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Miltie usually hope their child will grow to embody soldier of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
